modules.text:
A statue is a slow PE source, not a decoration with ambitions. Give it a sound base and place a [[Collector or Pedestal|guide_pe_machines]] within reach. Statues pass PE through solid blocks; height and distance still matter. A nearby Necronomicon may receive PE directly.

If the statue answers with a disruption, take the hint: there is a steadier way to harvest. See [[Places of Power|guide_places_of_power]]. The seven statue names are old and grand; their recipes use the matching charm, a Shadow Gem, and Monolith Stone.
